statement: Изменение состава не отменяется, если Baron умирает.
reason: Mechanical: the composition change survives the Baron's death. Missing assertion: kill the Baron after setup and assert the Townsfolk/Outsider counts and the dealt bag stay unchanged. TB-BARON-01 covers setup composition only.

statement: Если добавлен Drunk, применяются и его собственные инструкции подготовки.
reason: The Baron/Drunk test asserts the Drunk keeps roleId drunk and shownRoleId empath, is impaired, and takes the Empath step; the composition test covers the Outsider shift.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Baron adds two Outsiders and the Drunk keeps a false Townsfolk identity (TB-BARON-01, TB-DRUNK-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Baron.r2961.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Если Master опускает руку до подсчёта голоса Butler, Butler обязан немедленно опустить руку.
reason: A live table gesture: the Butler must lower a raised hand when the Master lowers theirs before the tally. The engine stores votes and emits a private warning after the fact; it has no hand state and no engine-visible consequence. Source: Butler r3120 Summary.

statement: Будучи мёртвым, Butler не имеет способности и может голосовать своим vote-жетоном в любое время.
reason: A dead Butler has no ability and may spend a vote token freely. Asserted by the dead-Butler vote test.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a dead Butler votes with their vote token without a master (TB-BUTLER-01) — butlerMaster is null, the nomination opens, recordVotes(['1']) counts the dead Butler's token, and butlerWarning stays empty.

statement: Butler может свободно поддерживать изгнание Traveller, поскольку изгнание не является голосованием.
reason: Mechanical: exile is not a vote, so the Butler may support it. Travellers and exile are not modelled. Missing assertion: an exile record that creates no butlerWarning and consumes no master restriction.

statement: Evil Travellers учитываются, если они присоединились к игре до действия Chef.
reason: Mechanical: evil Travellers count if they joined before the Chef acts. Travellers are not modelled. Missing assertion: an evil Traveller in the ring raises the Chef's computed count.

statement: Drunk не знает, что он Drunk; Ведущий не сообщает ему об этом.
reason: The mask is engine state: effectiveRoleId returns shownRoleId for the Drunk, the player snapshot exposes only shownRoleId, and the tests assert the real/shown split.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::Drunk keeps the real role and the shown role apart.
test: src/core/engine/setup.test.ts::the Drunk and Lunatic masks never become bluffs or public information (TB-DRUNK-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Drunk.r3165.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Drunk является Outsider, а не Townsfolk, для всех правил и способностей, проверяющих тип персонажа.
reason: The cited test asserts only that the Drunk is not a Townsfolk for the Virgin; no test asserts the Outsider half. The cited Summary does not say Outsider, so the source section must move to How to Run.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a Drunk nominator does not trigger the Virgin (TB-VIRGIN-01, TB-DRUNK-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Drunk.r3165.wikitext § How to Run — the Drunk is an Outsider.

statement: Информация Empath верна на рассвете, а не на закате, поскольку он действует после Demon.
reason: The Empath acts after the Demon, so its answer reflects the night's deaths. Asserted by the other-night queue.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::the other-night order places the Monk before the Imp and the Spy last (SYS-NIGHT-01) — the queue is ['poisoner','monk','imp','empath','fortuneteller','butler','spy'], placing the Empath after the Demon's attack.

statement: При подготовке первой ночи Ведущий назначает одного good-игрока Red Herring; он регистрируется как Demon для Fortune Teller всю игру.
reason: Mechanical: the Storyteller assigns one good player as the red herring at first-night setup and the same seat registers as a Demon all game. Missing assertion: default setup selects a good herring and a later night still answers yes for that seat. The herring tests configure the seat directly.

statement: Red Herring не знает, что он Red Herring, а Fortune Teller не знает, кто это.
reason: The herring is host-only and publicGameView emits no setup data, but no test asserts the herring is absent from player data; the register treats a missing privacy assertion as open work.
evidence: code: src/core/engine/setup.ts — the red herring is stored only in setup.
code: src/core/model/state.ts — publicGameView has no setup field.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Fortune_Teller.r3123.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Fortune Teller может выбрать мёртвого Demon и всё равно получить "да".
reason: Mechanical: a dead Demon still answers yes. Missing assertion: choose an already dead Demon seat and assert value true. The dead-player test pairs the dead seat with the Fortune Teller and expects false.

statement: Ведущий выбирает Red Herring; им может быть любой good-игрок, включая самого Fortune Teller.
reason: The Storyteller chooses the red herring, and any good player including the Fortune Teller is legal. Asserted by the setup command and the self-herring test.
evidence: src/core/engine/commands.test.ts::setup commands validate order, herring and bag patches — setHerring is allowed for a good player, rejected for an evil player, and can be cleared; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the Fortune Teller may be their own red herring — herringId '1' is a legal setup and answers yes.

statement: В маленьких играх иногда рекомендуется сделать Fortune Teller собственным Red Herring.
reason: Explicit Storyteller advice for small games. It prescribes no game state and has no engine-visible consequence. Source: Fortune Teller r3123 How to Run.

statement: Imp знает своих Minions и три good-персонажа, которых нет в игре, для блефа (Demon info).
reason: Mechanical: first-night demon info tells the Demon its Minions and three good, out-of-play characters. Missing assertion: the demoninfo step's information names the living Minions and exactly three good roles not in play. Only the bluff count and queue presence are asserted.

statement: На рассвете Ведущий объявляет, кто умер ночью, не называя причину.
reason: The acceptance finale asserts the public view names deaths without their causes, so players learn who died, not how.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/acceptance.test.ts::a played finale replays to the same state and exposes no secrets.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Imp.r3116.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Если Imp умирает, good побеждает, если только его смерть не запускает другую способность (например, Scarlet Woman) или Mastermind.
reason: The heir tests assert no winner when the Scarlet Woman inherits and a good win when the Demon has no heir; the Mastermind branch is separately covered.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Slayer shot at five alive lets the Scarlet Woman inherit the Demon role (TB-SLAYER-01, TB-SCARLETWOMAN-01).
test: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Slayer shot below five alive ends the game when the Demon has no heir (TB-SLAYER-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Imp.r3116.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Ведущий выбирает, какого Minion показать и каких двух игроков указать.
reason: The Storyteller chooses which Minion and which two players to show. Asserted by the prepared-answer record.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the investigator step keeps the prepared character and players as its record and writes one step line (TB-INVESTIGATOR-01) — the prepared roleId 'poisoner' and pair ['7','2'] are exposed and recorded unchanged.

statement: Reminder-жетоны Investigator рекомендуется убрать, когда это удобно.
reason: Reminder-token hygiene advice, not a game rule. Tokens are physical aids and have no engine-visible consequence. Source: Investigator r2983 How to Run.

statement: Если Librarian узнаёт Drunk как Outsider, он не узнаёт Townsfolk, которым Drunk себя считает.
reason: Mechanical: a Librarian shown the Drunk learns the Outsider 'drunk', never the Townsfolk mask the Drunk believes. Missing assertion: a game containing the Drunk and a Librarian offers 'drunk' (or the zero) and never the mask. Current tests cover a Drunk shown the Librarian, not the reverse.

statement: Ведущий выбирает, какого Outsider показать и каких двух игроков указать.
reason: The Storyteller chooses which Outsider and which two players to show. Asserted by the prepared-answer record.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the librarian step keeps the prepared character and players as its record and writes one step line (TB-LIBRARIAN-01) — the prepared roleId 'saint' and pair ['4','8'] are exposed and recorded unchanged.

statement: При перенаправлении смерти игроки узнают только, кто умер, но не почему.
reason: The acceptance finale asserts the public view names deaths without causes; the Mayor redirect is journaled for the host, not disclosed to the group.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/acceptance.test.ts::a played finale replays to the same state and exposes no secrets.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Mayor.r2995.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Travellers считаются игроками для победы Mayor и должны быть изгнаны до неё; изгнание не является казнью.
reason: Mechanical: Travellers count as players for the Mayor win and must be exiled before it; exile is not execution. Travellers are not modelled. Missing assertion: a live Traveller blocks the three-alive Mayor win and an exile is not an execution.

statement: Fabled не считаются игроками для победы Mayor.
reason: Mechanical: Fabled are not players for the Mayor win. Fabled are not modelled. Missing assertion: a Fabled in play does not change the three-alive Mayor win.

statement: Если Ведущий перенаправляет атаку на мёртвого игрока, Soldier или защищённого Monk, этот игрок не умирает этой ночью.
reason: Every branch of the redirect sentence is asserted: a dead target, a Soldier, and a Monk-protected target all leave the Mayor alive and kill nobody.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::Mayor redirect to a dead player kills nobody and the Mayor lives (TB-MAYOR-01) — noDeath and the Mayor survives; src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Mayor redirect to a living Soldier kills nobody (TB-MAYOR-01, TB-SOLDIER-01); src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Mayor redirect to a Monk-protected player kills nobody (TB-MAYOR-01, TB-MONK-01).

statement: Ведущему рекомендуется сохранять Mayor живым до финального дня; в редких случаях, если группа уверена в Mayor слишком рано, можно позволить ему умереть.
reason: Explicit Storyteller advice about pacing and keeping the Mayor alive. It prescribes no game state and has no engine-visible consequence. Source: Mayor r2995 How to Run.

statement: Monk не защищает от казни днём.
reason: Mechanical: Monk protection does not stop a day execution. Missing assertion: execute a Monk-protected player and assert the death with no protection effect. TB-MONK-01 covers protection from the Demon only.

statement: Защита Monk предотвращает и другие вредные эффекты способности Demon, например отравление или смену alignment.
reason: The pinned sentence is explicitly other-editions: a TB Demon has no non-killing ability, and mixed-edition scripts are rejected. There is no TB mechanical input.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Monk.r3124.wikitext § How to Run — in other editions, Demons may have abilities other than killing.
test: src/core/engine/scripts.test.ts::script limits reject mixed editions, unknown roles and short rosters.

statement: На рассвете Ведущий объявляет, что ночью никто не умер, не объясняя причину.
reason: A no-death night yields an empty public deaths list; the read-model and Monk tests assert no death record for the protected player.
evidence: test: src/application/read-models/read-models.test.ts::the public snapshot matches the legacy projection.
test: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::Monk protection stops the Imp; a poisoned Monk does not (TB-MONK-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Monk.r3124.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Отравленный игрок не имеет способности, но Ведущий изображает её наличие и может давать ложную информацию.
reason: The poisoned player's ability has no effect, and the Storyteller may give false information. Both clauses are asserted by existing tests.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a poisoned Monk protects no one and the Imp's attack kills (TB-MONK-01) — the poisoned ability has no effect; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::every Trouble Brewing first-night information role offers allowed false information while impaired (SYS-EFFECTS-01, TB-EMPATH-03) — each impaired information role is offered false information.

statement: Отравленный игрок просыпается и действует как обычно, не зная об отравлении.
reason: The poisoned player still wakes for their step. Asserted by the poisoned Spy step; the player's ignorance is table information with no engine state.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a poisoned Spy is shown the grimoire without a question and the step is marked impaired (TB-SPY-01, SYS-EFFECTS-01) — the poisoned player still has and completes the night step, marked impaired.

statement: Если отравленный игрок использует способность "once per game", она считается использованной.
reason: A poisoned player's once-per-game ability counts as used. Asserted by the poisoned Slayer shot.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a poisoned Slayer spends the once-per-game ability without killing (TB-SLAYER-01) — used.slayer is true and the target stays alive.

statement: Если Poisoner покидает игру или меняет персонажа, эффект отравления прекращается.
reason: The test kills the Poisoner and clears the effect, but the cited Examples section covers only becoming the Imp; the leaves-the-game clause is in How to Run.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a dead player's persistent ability effects end immediately (SYS-EFFECTS-05).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Poisoner.r1737.wikitext § How to Run.

statement: Ravenkeeper может выбрать мёртвого игрока.
reason: The Ravenkeeper may choose a dead player. Asserted by the dead-Recluse answer.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a Recluse may be shown to the Ravenkeeper as a Minion or the Demon, alive or dead (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01, TB-RECLUSE-01) — the later branch targets the dead Recluse with targetIds ['2'] and completes the step.

statement: Если Ravenkeeper умирает днём, способность не срабатывает.
reason: A daytime death does not trigger the Ravenkeeper's ability. Asserted by the execution branch.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::the Ravenkeeper wakes only after a night death, never after an execution (TB-RAVENKEEPER-01) — after a day execution of the Ravenkeeper the next night's queue has no ravenkeeper step.

statement: Ведущему рекомендуется не позволять игрокам обсуждать свои ночные действия в момент их совершения.
reason: Advice about table conduct: not letting players discuss their night actions while they happen. It has no engine-visible consequence. Source: Ravenkeeper r3125 How to Run.

statement: Recluse может регистрироваться как good или evil и как Outsider, Minion или Demon в разные моменты одной ночи.
reason: Mechanical: one Recluse may register differently at different moments of the same night. Missing assertion: two abilities in one night see different Recluse registrations. The registration tests pass one map per check.

statement: Если Recluse регистрируется как конкретный Minion или Demon, он не получает способность этого персонажа.
reason: Mechanical: registering as a Minion or Demon does not grant that character's ability. Missing assertion: a Recluse registered as the Imp never gains an Imp attack or night step.

statement: Recluse остаётся good и выигрывает с good, несмотря на регистрацию evil.
reason: Mechanical: the Recluse remains good and wins with good despite an evil registration. Missing assertion: a registered-evil Recluse still counts as good for the winner check. Current tests assert registered alignment only.

statement: Если Saint стал evil и был казнён, good побеждает.
reason: Mechanical: an evil-aligned Saint executed by the town still makes good win. Missing assertion: give the Saint an evil alignment, execute them, and assert winner good with reason saint.

statement: Если казнь Saint отменена другой способностью (например, вместо него умирает другой игрок), Saint не умирает и игра продолжается.
reason: Mechanical: an execution of the Saint cancelled by another ability leaves the Saint alive and the game running. Missing assertion: a cancelled Saint execution records no saint loss and no winner.

statement: После превращения Scarlet Woman является Demon во всех отношениях: атакует ночью, регистрируется как Demon, good побеждает при её смерти.
reason: Mechanical: after succession the Scarlet Woman is a Demon in all respects — she attacks, registers as a Demon, and good wins on her death. Missing assertion: the new Demon's attack step kills and her death sets winner good. The tests cover the five-player threshold and the wake only.

statement: Travellers не учитываются при подсчёте пяти живых игроков.
reason: Mechanical: Travellers do not count toward the five living. Travellers are not modelled. Missing assertion: a live Traveller is excluded from the five-player count.

statement: Выбор мёртвого Demon не убивает его, поскольку мёртвый не может умереть снова.
reason: A shot at a dead Demon kills nobody because a dead player cannot die again. Asserted by the dead-Demon shot.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Slayer shot at a dead Demon does nothing and spends the ability (TB-SLAYER-01) — hit is false, used.slayer is true, and no death is recorded.

statement: Soldier защищён и от других вредных эффектов способности Demon, например от отравления или смены alignment.
reason: The pinned sentence is other-editions: a TB Soldier cannot face a non-killing Demon, and mixed-edition scripts are rejected.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Soldier.r3121.wikitext § How to Run — in other editions.
test: src/core/engine/scripts.test.ts::script limits reject mixed editions, unknown roles and short rosters.

statement: Soldier может умереть от казни, даже если номинировал его Demon.
reason: Mechanical: the Soldier can die by execution. Missing assertion: execute the Soldier and assert the death. TB-SOLDIER-01 covers only the Demon attack.

statement: Spy может регистрироваться как good и как конкретный Townsfolk или Outsider, в том числе как разные персонажи в одну ночь.
reason: Mechanical: the Spy may register differently at different moments of the same night. Missing assertion: two abilities in one night see different Spy registrations.

statement: Если Spy регистрируется как конкретный Townsfolk или Outsider, он не получает способность этого персонажа.
reason: Mechanical: registering as a Townsfolk or Outsider does not grant that character's ability. Missing assertion: a Spy registered as a Townsfolk never gets that role's night step or effect.

statement: Spy остаётся evil и выигрывает с evil, несмотря на регистрацию good.
reason: Mechanical: the Spy remains evil and wins with evil despite a good registration. Missing assertion: a registered-good Spy still counts as evil for the winner check.

statement: Смерти днём не от казни (например, от чужой способности) и изгнание Traveller не учитываются.
reason: Mechanical: a daytime death not caused by execution (for example a Slayer shot) and a Traveller exile do not give the Undertaker a character. Missing assertion: a Slayer daytime kill followed by the Undertaker night step. Tests cover execution versus night death only.

statement: При нескольких казнях со смертью в день Ведущий выбирает, какого персонажа показать.
reason: Trouble Brewing has one execution per day; the extra-execution clause is explicitly other-editions and has no TB input.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Undertaker.r3115.wikitext § How to Run — in Trouble Brewing there is one execution per day; other editions differ.

statement: Немедленная казнь завершает процесс номинации и день переходит к ночи; другая казнь в этот день невозможна.
reason: The immediate execution clears the nomination ledger and ends the day. Asserted across two tests.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::Virgin executes only the first eligible Townsfolk nominator (TB-VIRGIN-01) — execution cause is 'virgin' and day.nominations is empty; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::table Virgin control executes a qualifying nominator and persists the death reference — day.ended is true.

statement: Если номинировавший не Townsfolk, ничего не происходит и голосование продолжается как обычно.
reason: A non-Townsfolk nominator triggers nothing and the nomination remains open. Asserted by the Drunk nominator.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::Drunk nominator does not trigger the Virgin — result.virgin is false, the nominator stays alive, and day.nominations.length is 1, so the nomination ledger stays open.

statement: После первой номинации Virgin теряет способность — независимо от того, умер номинировавший или нет, и даже если Virgin был drunk или poisoned.
reason: The ability is spent after the first nomination whether the nominator lives or dies and even when the Virgin is impaired. Asserted across three tests.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::an impaired Virgin's first nomination still spends the ability — used.virgin is true with an active poison; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a Spy that does not register as a Townsfolk leaves the Virgin alive but spent — used.virgin is true although the nominator lives; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::Virgin executes only the first eligible Townsfolk nominator — the nominator dies and the Virgin stays alive, covering the nominator-death branch.

statement: Мёртвый игрок не может номинировать, поэтому его номинация не считается первой номинацией Virgin и не лишает Virgin способности.
reason: Mechanical: a dead player cannot nominate, so a nominal nomination is not the Virgin's first and does not spend the ability. Missing assertion: attempt a dead-player nomination and assert refusal plus used.virgin staying false. The BMR Zombuul test covers dead nomination only for that role.

statement: Второй показанный игрок может быть персонажем любого типа и любого alignment.
reason: Mechanical: the second player shown may be of any character type and alignment. Missing assertion: prepare a Washerwoman pair whose non-matching player is evil or the Demon and assert the answer is accepted and recorded.

statement: Ведущий выбирает, какого Townsfolk показать и каких двух игроков указать.
reason: The Storyteller chooses which Townsfolk and which two players are shown. Asserted by the prepared-answer read.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a one-of-two step shows what is prepared at the moment it is read (TB-WASHERWOMAN-01) — a changed prepared roleId 'empath' and pair ['6','3'] are shown, proving the Storyteller's choice is the source.

statement: Reminder-жетоны Washerwoman рекомендуется убрать, когда это удобно.
reason: Reminder-token hygiene advice, not a game rule. Tokens are physical aids and have no engine-visible consequence. Source: Washerwoman r2630 How to Run.
